libs.note: BH-9441. The plan gate counts the rows of the plan's `## Requirements coverage` table against the top-level items of the ticket body's `## Scope` list (body only, never comments). Resolved by cr_conf through lib_env_apply in a subshell, then the env, then CR_DEFAULT_ENFORCE in bin/lib/coverage-rows.sh, which equals the default here (tests/coverage-rows.bh-9441-test.sh K1).

knobs.note: 1: a plan whose `## Requirements coverage` table has fewer rows than the ticket body's `## Scope` has items is refused (rc 2, the plan gate's repair pass, then PLAN_MALFORMED). 0: the gate writes a NOTE line and `PLAN_COVERAGE: short (not enforced, ...)` only. Applies only to tickets whose body carries a Scope list.
